Chief Justice and CM Perform Ancestral Rites

Chief Justice Suryakant performed prayers to Mother Ganga and offered 'tarpan' for his ancestors at Gangotri Dham. Separately, Chief Minister Mohan Yadav performed 'tarpan' in the Falgu River in Gaya, observing religious traditions for the peace of his ancestors.
